body.text:
# Competitor teardown

## Next steps

The pilot showed that pre-orders cut waste more than they lift sales. Lead with waste. Uses WhatsApp groups to tell regulars what came in.

## What we heard

Restaurants buy in bulk early in the morning; they are a different product from weekend shoppers. Would pay 2 € more to skip the queue.

- Came back three Saturdays in a row after the reminder
- Only 1 in 8 stalls takes cards

## Numbers

Most stalls run on cash and WhatsApp; anything we build has to fit that before it replaces it. Would pay 2 € more to skip the queue.

- Did not want to install another app
- Bought the same basket four weeks running
